A container initially contains n gallons of water. A student adds 15 gallons of water, making the container 60% full. After the student adds 10 more gallons of water, the container is 80% full.

Select the correct answers from each drop-down to complete the sentences.

Let x represent the total number of gallons the container can hold. 

The equation that represents the situation immediately after the student adds 15 gallons of water is \(n+15=\)   {{dropdown-1}} .

The equation that represents the situation after the student adds 10 gallons of water is \(n+25=\)   {{dropdown-2}} .

The number of gallons, n , in the container initially is {{dropdown-3}} gallons.
